card.name: End of table column headers
card.fires_on: The closing parenthesis or last word of a column heading in a dosing or drug-interaction table, right before the next column's heading begins. It also fires on a few table-title words like 'per Body' or a space between header cells.

modes.label: Closing bracket of a header
modes.description: A ')' that ends a column heading such as a size, dose or drug label, just before the next column.
